title: Keep it safe
headline: Keep it *safe*
sub: Approvals for money going out, and the app lock.

recap.en: Money moves all day. How does Ada keep it safe?
recap.pcm: Money dey move all day. How Ada go keep am safe?

flow.purpose: he asks to pay the supplier
flow.action: Looks at his phone, taps Send, then glances across the kitchen at Ada, who is at the stove
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer

flow.action: Reads her phone, checks the amount, nods and taps once with a firm smile
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer

flow.action: Stands in the kitchen doorway at dusk, looks back at the clean counter and smiles with quiet pride
flow.setting: Ada's Kitchen in Yaba: white tiles, steel counters, big steaming pots, a bright window onto a yellow-painted wall, a counter with a receipt printer, evening lamp light

en: She sees who asks, and how much.
First payment to this account: check the details.
She adds a comment. It is recorded.
pcm: She see who ask, and how much.
Na first payment to this account: check the details.
She add comment. E go dey record.
Approve, and the card go clear.

en: Ada turns on the app lock.
In Settings, she taps App lock.
She chooses when it asks: at once, or after a while.
Later, Taskiem is locked until she proves it is her.
pcm: Ada turn on the app lock.
For Settings, she tap App lock.
The phone dey check her fingerprint.
She fit choose when e go ask: at once, or after small time.
Later, Taskiem go lock until she prove say na her.
